verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an official MCP server that gives AI assistants its search and reasoning tools. It comes in two forms: a recommended remote server hosted at api.perplexity.ai/mcp, and an open-source local stdio server for clients that need it. The docs also cover tool-restriction controls and MCP-connector usage, and a probe confirmed the MCP server page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent through the server.
